WITH candidates AS (SELECT s.*, (SELECT f.roe FROM financials f WHERE f.stock_id=s.id
            AND lower(trim(f.period_type))='annual' AND f.validation_version=1
            AND f.roe IS NOT NULL
            AND f.provenance->'roe'->>'validation_status' IN ('provider','normalized','recomputed')
            AND (f.period_end IS NULL OR f.period_end<=:today)
            AND (f.provenance->'roe'->>'period_end' IS NULL OR f.provenance->'roe'->>'period_end'<=CAST(:today AS text))
            ORDER BY f.provenance->'roe'->>'period_end' DESC NULLS LAST,
            f.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, f.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, f.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS roe,(SELECT f.revenue_growth FROM financials f WHERE f.stock_id=s.id
